newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SCORERS IN ITALIAN FIRST DIVISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCORERS IN ITALIAN FIRST DIVISION.

text.p: Leading scorers in Italian first division after matches on Sunday:
9 - Abel Balbo (Roma), Vincenzo Montella (Sampdoria), Marcelo Otero (Vicenza)
7 - Gabriel Batistuta (Fiorentina), George Weah (Milan), Youri Djorkaeff (Inter), Giuseppe Signori (Lazio)
6 - Oliver Bierhoff (Udinese), Igor Kolyvanov (Bologna), Enrico Chiesa (Parma), Luis Oliveira (Fiorentina)
5 - Alfredo Aglietti (Napoli), Alessandro Del Piero (Juventus), Filippo Maniero (Verona), Paolo Poggi (Udinese)
4 - Demetrio Albertini and Roberto Baggio (both Milan), Nicola Caccia and Andre Cruz (both Napoli), Carmine Gautieri
(Perugia), Giampiero Maini (Vicenza), Roberto Muzzi and Sandro Tovalieri (both Cagliari), Michele Padovano (Juventus)
